 Paris Saint-Germain are top of Ligue 1 at 5-1-0 and bring a run of eleven consecutive wins in all competitions to the Allianz Riviera. Nice, sixth at 2-1-2, are a different kind of opponent from the ones PSG have been dispatching. They beat Angers 2-0 before the international break, and they are tough to read in front of goal.
 For Nice, Elye Wahi has 6 goals and 14 shots on target, which is the sharpest finishing profile in the squad. Sofiane Diop and Mohamed Amoura have both created 13 chances, and each has 2 goals and more than one assist. Diop has 3 assists and Amoura 2, so Nice have more than one way to get the ball to Wahi.
 PSG have depth across their attack. Ferran Torres has 4 goals and 13 shots on target, and Achraf Hakimi has 3 goals and 2 assists from the flank. Vitinha leads the visitors with 15 chances created, and Desire Doue has 13 and 7 shots on target. Nice’s defense will have to deal with threats from several directions rather than a single focal point.

 Game Preview
 PSG sit first with 16 points and a +10 goal difference, and they are chasing a sixth consecutive Ligue 1 title. Nice are sixth with 7 points and a goal difference of 0, so they have scored and conceded evenly. That balance gives them a chance to close the gap on the teams above them.
 The head-to-head history favors the visitors. Nice have won only one of their last six meetings with PSG, and the Parisians have won seven of their last nine visits to Nice.
 What to Watch For
 Wahi is the Nice attacker to watch. His 6 goals and 14 shots on target show a player who finds space and gets his shot away. Jonathan Clauss has 13 chances created, and Gauthier Hein has 3 assists, so the service behind Wahi is there. If Nice are going to disrupt a team that has won eleven straight, those chances will need to turn into goals.
 For PSG, Torres has 4 goals and 13 shots on target, while Hakimi’s 3 goals and 2 assists come from a wide position. Marquinhos has 3 goals of his own, a reminder that PSG can score from set pieces and from deeper positions as well as from the front line.
 The midfield contest is another thing to watch. Vitinha has 15 chances created and Fabian Ruiz has 11, so PSG can pick a pass from the middle of the pitch. Nice will have to decide how tightly to press them.
